name: Humanity
source:
The future.
There are living things that cannot be seen as human.
They come from test tubes.
Subhumans.
They laugh and walk and play.

Day after day after day.

An adventure game about the pursuit of humanity.
Let it begin.

[from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE062606.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
未来。
有些生命体无法被视作人类。
他们诞生于试管。
亚人。
他们欢笑、行走、玩耍。

日复一日，日复一日。

一款追寻人性的冒险游戏。
现在开始。

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE062606.html]DLsite English[/url]]
